observed_in: Shop and Economy System design analysis

definition: This dimension controls how and when shops or NPCs restock their inventory, influencing player strategy regarding timing and resource management. Variations can include fixed restock intervals, dynamic restocking based on player actions, or unique event-driven restocks.
exclusion_criteria: Shops that only offer a fixed selection of items
inclusion_criteria: Shops restock based on player actions or dungeon events
title: Restocking Mechanics in Shop Systems
